verdict.rationale: Adyen documents splitting a payment across one or more users' balance accounts. The platform takes its cut through the marketplace's liable balance account, and split instructions can be passed on payment and chargeback endpoints. Chargeback splitting covers part of the reversal story, but adjusting a split after capture is not documented, and splits are request instructions rather than standalone API objects. Missing for 10: documented post-capture split adjustment, refund/reversal split handling beyond chargebacks, evidence that splits are first-class addressable API objects, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can split one charge among any set of parties — route funds to multiple sellers, take my cut, and reverse or adjust the split later, all as first-class API objects

citations.quote: You can split the payments between one or more users, deduct costs as needed, and hold funds until payout.
